summary: Unfold ∏G₁ as (∏𝖴) × (quotient); integrate the cutoff over ∏𝖴 first.

steps.claim: By the product unfolding (measurePreserving_pi_orbitMeasure for besselHaar), y = u·x with u ∈ ∏𝖴 and x in the quotient; by 𝖴-invariance the integrand is β_c(u·x)·∏ w_v(x_v); by Tonelli the integral over u gives ν (lintegral_classCutoff_eq_unipCovolume) and the integral over x factors into ∏_v ∫ w_v (lintegral_pi_prod).
